# Code of Conduct

Kaggle Development Kit aims to keep collaboration professional, respectful, and technically focused.

## Expected behavior

Participants are expected to:

- communicate respectfully and assume good faith while discussing technical disagreements;
- give and receive constructive feedback without personal attacks;
- respect different levels of experience, backgrounds, and viewpoints;
- keep issue and pull-request discussions relevant to the project;
- respect privacy and never publish another person's credentials, private data, or sensitive runtime information;
- follow maintainer requests intended to keep discussions safe, focused, and productive.

## Unacceptable behavior

The project does not accept harassment, threats, discriminatory or demeaning language, sustained disruption, deliberate disclosure of private information, impersonation, or other behavior that would be inappropriate in a professional engineering community.

## Scope and enforcement

This policy applies to repository issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions related to the project, and public interactions in which someone is representing the project.

Maintainers may edit or remove inappropriate content, close or lock discussions, reject contributions, or temporarily or permanently restrict participation when necessary to protect the community and project.

For a sensitive conduct report, do not open a public issue. Contact the maintainer privately at `i.am@dangkhoa.dev` with enough context to evaluate the report. Reports will be handled with discretion to the extent reasonably possible.

## Attribution

This policy is informed by the principles of the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), including its current community-safety guidance, while using project-specific wording and enforcement guidance.
